_readme: Persistent fetch-failure ledger for the Las Azules S2 media sweep routine. Sweeps must read this before attempting any body fetch on a candidate URL and skip anything currently in cooldown, rendering the skip on the sweep evidence line. failCount tracks consecutive full fallback-chain failures (WebFetch AND Firecrawl scrape both failed in the same attempt). Three consecutive full-chain failures sets cooldownUntil to 30 days out. After cooldown expires, the URL gets one retry (WebFetch then Firecrawl); success resets failCount to 0 and clears cooldownUntil, failure restarts the 30-day cooldown. See LEMA-9620 for origin and LEMA-9619 for the incident that motivated this file.

history.note: Fallback chain resolved it. Firecrawl returned the real article body (a syndicated Variety renewal story, byline Joe Otterson, dated 2025-05-20). WebFetch alone still fails (403/202 zero-byte bot wall) but the standing fallback now succeeds, so this URL is not placed in cooldown. See LEMA-9620 deliverable for the decision reasoning.
